sfx_review.label: music
sfx_review.note: Broadband onset ~300 ms before the push; matches the regular beat pattern seen across the spectrogram rather than a discrete impact tied to the motion.

pattern.description: The camera pushes in (~14% scale) on a Datadog dashboard toward an open metric context menu while the surrounding dashboard dims, with a static tilted caption banner on top.
pattern.why_premium: Combining a slow push-in with dimming of everything except the menu guides the eye to the one-click pivot options without a cursor or callout, keeping the real UI as the hero.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.fromTo('.screen', {scale: 1, transformOrigin: '25% 60%'}, {scale: 1.14, duration: 0.7, ease: 'power2.inOut'}); simultaneously gsap.to('.dim-overlay', {opacity: 0.55, duration: 0.6, ease: 'power1.out'}) with the menu layered above the overlay. Caption banner stays fixed outside the scaled group.
build_hint.remotion: scale = interpolate(frame, [0, 21], [1, 1.14], {easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.cubic), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}) on the screenshot container with transformOrigin near the menu; overlay opacity interpolate(frame, [0, 18], [0, 0.55]). No spring (smooth camera ease).

notes: Dim of dashboard vs menu is inferred from filmstrip brightness; the energy curve peaks mid-burst consistent with an ease-in-out push. Menu has manual_box.
